description: ASX announcements across ALL listed companies for one Sydney trading day, newest first, with optional filtering: which companies announced a dividend or an on-market buy-back today, who issued a trading halt, which results are out. Each row has the ticker, company name, sector, time (Sydney), headline, ASX announcement types (ASX's own labels, e.g. "Dividend Rate", "Daily Share Buy-Back Notice"), price-sensitive flag, a derived category (the same ones as asx_get_announcements plus dividend) and a document link. Filter by category, by keyword (matches headline or ASX type), or price-sensitive only; date defaults to the latest day ASX has published. No ticker needed; use asx_get_announcements for one company's history over months. Source: ASX company announcements.

category.description: Only this derived category; "dividend" matches dividend and distribution notices

date.description: Sydney calendar day, YYYY-MM-DD (default: latest day with announcements). ASX keeps only the most recent few days in this feed.

keyword.description: Case-insensitive text matched against the headline and ASX announcement types, e.g. "buy-back", "dividend", "takeover"

name: asx_market_announcements
title: Asx Market Announcements
